title: Baseline
description: Result of running the suite with no mutation applied.

run_id.description:
Identifier of the run this baseline belongs to, so a stale baseline
paired with fresh results is detectable.

ExitClass.description:
Neutral runner exit classification. The Python pack maps pytest exit codes
onto these: 0 to `ok`, 1 to `test_failures`, 5 to `no_tests`, 2 to
`interrupted`, 3 and 4 to `infra_error`.

oneOf.description: The suite ran and every test passed.
The suite ran and reported failures or errors.
The suite ran but collected no tests.
The run was interrupted before finishing.
The runner itself failed, through bad usage or an internal error.

RunnerResult.description: What one test-suite execution reported, in language-neutral terms.

collected_ids_hash.description:
SHA-256 of the sorted collected test identifiers. Detects a changed test
set even when `collected` is unchanged.

errors.description: Tests that errored during setup or teardown.

exit_class.description: Neutral classification of how the runner exited.

failed.description: Tests that failed an assertion or raised inside the test body.

timed_out.description: Whether the runner stopped the suite on its own time limit.
